title: OVH Cloud tells users to expect 87% price rise — with gaming servers hit particularly hard
summary: This marks the steepest increase across the board; otherwise, Gen 2026 servers saw a +51% increase in cost, even as OVHCloud states that existing options would see a lower overall increase in cost and that existing commitments would see "nothing change".
